import json, os, sys, re, base64, py_compile

event_path = os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_PATH')
bpy_script = ''
w1 = ''
w2 = ''
w3 = ''
w4 = ''

if event_path and os.path.exists(event_path):
    try:
        with open(event_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as ef:
            event_data = json.load(ef)
            payload = event_data.get('client_payload', {})
            
            # Support base64 model payloads if passed directly
            input_model_b64 = payload.get('input_model_b64', '')
            if input_model_b64 and input_model_b64.strip():
                try:
                    with open('input_model.glb', 'wb') as mf:
                        mf.write(base64.b64decode(input_model_b64))
                    os.makedirs('inputs', exist_ok=True)
                    with open('inputs/input_model.glb', 'wb') as mf2:
                        mf2.write(base64.b64decode(input_model_b64))
                    print("Successfully unpacked user input 3D model: input_model.glb")
                except Exception as me:
                    print(f"Warning unpacking user model: {me}")

            # Support uploaded custom scripts and dynamic payloads via Base64
            if 'bpy_script_b64' in payload and payload['bpy_script_b64'].strip():
                bpy_script = base64.b64decode(payload['bpy_script_b64']).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
            elif 'bpy_script' in payload:
                candidate = payload['bpy_script'].strip()
                if candidate.startswith('b64:'):
                    bpy_script = base64.b64decode(candidate[4:]).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                else:
                    bpy_script = candidate
                    
            w1 = payload.get('w1StructureScript', payload.get('w1HeroScript', ''))
            w2 = payload.get('w2DetailsScript', payload.get('w2EnvScript', ''))
            w3 = payload.get('w3MaterialsScript', payload.get('w3LightScript', ''))
            w4 = payload.get('w4CinematicsScript', '')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Note on GITHUB_EVENT_PATH read: {e}")

# Fallback to environment variables
if not bpy_script:
    env_s = os.environ.get('BPY_SCRIPT', '').strip()
    if env_s.startswith('b64:'):
        try:
            bpy_script = base64.b64decode(env_s[4:]).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
        except Exception:
            bpy_script = env_s
    else:
        bpy_script = env_s

if not w1: w1 = os.environ.get('W1_STRUCTURE', '')
if not w2: w2 = os.environ.get('W2_DETAILS', '')
if not w3: w3 = os.environ.get('W3_MATERIALS', '')
if not w4: w4 = os.environ.get('W4_CINEMATICS', '')

# Assemble dynamic modular scripts if provided separately
if not bpy_script.strip() and (w1.strip() or w2.strip() or w3.strip() or w4.strip()):
    bpy_script = (
        "import bpy, os, math, random, sys, traceback\n\n"
        "os.makedirs('output', exist_ok=True)\n"
        "bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')\n"
        "bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)\n\n"
        f"# --- W1: STRUCTURE ---\n{w1}\n\n"
        f"# --- W2: DETAILS & PROPS ---\n{w2}\n\n"
        f"# --- W3: PBR MATERIALS ---\n{w3}\n\n"
        f"# --- W4: LIGHTING & CAM ---\n{w4}\n"
    )

if not bpy_script.strip():
    err_msg = "FATAL ERROR: No Blender Python script provided in payload."
    print(err_msg)
    with open('output/error.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as ef:
        ef.write(err_msg + '\n')
    sys.exit(1)

# --- AST & REGEX AUTO-REPAIR PIPELINE ---

# Auto-Repair 1: Neutralize unstable headless addon registrations (e.g. rigify, archimesh in 4.2)
bpy_script = re.sub(r"addon_utils\.enable\(['\"](?:rigify|archimesh)['\"]\)", "pass", bpy_script)

# Auto-Repair 2: Fix unquoted node lookups
bpy_script = re.sub(r'nodes\.get\(\s*([A-Za-z0-9_ ]+)\s*\)', lambda m: f'nodes.get("{m.group(1).strip()}")' if '"' not in m.group(1) and "'" not in m.group(1) else m.group(0), bpy_script)

# Auto-Repair 3: Fix unquoted f-strings
bpy_script = re.sub(r'(?<=[=\s,(])f([a-zA-Z0-9_]+\{[^}"\n]+\}[a-zA-Z0-9_]*)', r'f"\1"', bpy_script)

# Auto-Repair 4: Fix hallucinated operator names
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace(".primitive_cube_create(", ".primitive_cube_add(")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace(".primitive_plane_create(", ".primitive_plane_add(")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace(".primitive_cylinder_create(", ".primitive_cylinder_add(")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace(".primitive_cone_create(", ".primitive_cone_add(")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace(".primitive_uv_sphere_create(", ".primitive_uv_sphere_add(")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace("bpy.ops.light.add(", "bpy.ops.object.light_add(")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace("bpy.ops.camera.add(", "bpy.ops.object.camera_add(")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace("bpy.ops.object.mesh.", "bpy.ops.mesh.")

# Auto-Repair 5: Blender 4.2+ Principled BSDF socket name updates
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace("['Transmission'].default_value", "['Transmission Weight'].default_value")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace("['Subsurface'].default_value", "['Subsurface Weight'].default_value")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace("['Specular'].default_value", "['Specular IOR Level'].default_value")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace("['BaseColor']", "['Base Color']")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace('["BaseColor"]', '["Base Color"]')
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace("'BLENDER_EEVEE'", "'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'")
bpy_script = bpy_script.replace('"BLENDER_EEVEE"', '"BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT"')

# Auto-Repair 6: Blender 4.2+ AgX Color Management Look Enums (Fixes "High Contrast" enum error)
look_fixes = [
    (r"view_settings\.look\s*=\s*['\"]High Contrast['\"]", "view_settings.look = 'AgX - High Contrast'"),
    (r"view_settings\.look\s*=\s*['\"]Very High Contrast['\"]", "view_settings.look = 'AgX - Very High Contrast'"),
    (r"view_settings\.look\s*=\s*['\"]Medium High Contrast['\"]", "view_settings.look = 'AgX - Medium High Contrast'"),
    (r"view_settings\.look\s*=\s*['\"]Medium Low Contrast['\"]", "view_settings.look = 'AgX - Medium Low Contrast'"),
    (r"view_settings\.look\s*=\s*['\"]Low Contrast['\"]", "view_settings.look = 'AgX - Low Contrast'"),
    (r"view_settings\.look\s*=\s*['\"]Very Low Contrast['\"]", "view_settings.look = 'AgX - Very Low Contrast'"),
    (r"view_settings\.look\s*=\s*['\"]Base Contrast['\"]", "view_settings.look = 'AgX - Base Contrast'"),
    (r"view_settings\.look\s*=\s*['\"]Punchy['\"]", "view_settings.look = 'AgX - Punchy'")
]
for pattern, replacement in look_fixes:
    bpy_script = re.sub(pattern, replacement, bpy_script)

# Auto-Repair 7: Wrap view_settings.look in try-except block to ensure immunity from look enum failures
bpy_script = re.sub(
    r"^([ \t]*)(.*view_settings\.look\s*=.*)$",
    r"\1try:\n\1    \2\n\1except Exception as _look_err: print(f'View settings look notice: {_look_err}')",
    bpy_script,
    flags=re.MULTILINE
)

# Auto-Repair 8: Redirect FBX imports to GLTF if converted or if model exists as GLB (Safe Quote Preservation)
has_glb = os.path.exists('input_model.glb') or os.path.exists('inputs/input_model.glb')
if has_glb:
    bpy_script = bpy_script.replace("bpy.ops.import_scene.fbx(", "bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(")
    bpy_script = re.sub(r"(['\"])([^'\"\n]*?)\.fbx(['\"])", r"\1\2.glb\3", bpy_script)
    print("Auto-Repair: Successfully redirected scene FBX import to converted GLB format.")

# Auto-Repair 9: SCOPED Texture Type Fix (Never corrupt light or curve types!)
valid_tex = {'NONE', 'BLEND', 'CLOUDS', 'DISTORTED_NOISE', 'IMAGE', 'MAGIC', 'MARBLE', 'MUSGRAVE', 'NOISE', 'STUCCI', 'VORONOI', 'WOOD'}
def fix_texture_type(m):
    prefix = m.group(1)
    tex_val = m.group(2)
    suffix = m.group(3)
    if tex_val not in valid_tex:
        tex_val = 'CLOUDS'
    return prefix + tex_val + suffix
bpy_script = re.sub(r"(textures\.new\([^)]*type\s*=\s*['\"])([A-Za-z0-9_]+)(['\"])", fix_texture_type, bpy_script)

# Auto-Repair 10: Ensure standard GLTF/GLB export exists with baked modifiers
if 'export_scene.gltf' not in bpy_script:
    bpy_script += (
        "\n\n# Standard Model Exporter with Baked Modifiers\n"
        "import bpy, os\n"
        "os.makedirs('output', exist_ok=True)\n"
        "try:\n"
        "    bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath='output/model.glb', export_format='GLB', export_apply=True, export_skins=True, export_animations=True)\n"
        "    print('3D GLTF Export Successful: output/model.glb')\n"
        "except Exception as ge: print(f'GLTF export warning: {ge}')\n"
    )

# Auto-Repair 11: Production Denoised Cycles Snapshot (16 samples for rapid cloud execution)

        "\n\n# High-Fidelity Denoised Viewport Snapshot\n"
        "try:\n"

        "    if not os.path.exists('output/render.png'):\n"

        "            bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(5, -5, 4), rotation=(math.radians(60), 0, math.radians(45)))\n"
        "            bpy.context.scene.camera = bpy.context.active_object\n"
        "        bpy.context.scene.render.engine = 'CYCLES'\n"
        "        bpy.context.scene.cycles.device = 'CPU'\n"
        "        bpy.context.scene.cycles.samples = 16\n"

        "        bpy.context.scene.render.resolution_x = 1280\n"
        "        bpy.context.scene.render.resolution_y = 720\n"
        "        bpy.context.scene.render.filepath = 'output/render.png'\n"
        "        bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)\n"

bpy_script = re.sub(r"(bg(?:_node)?\.outputs\[['\"])Color(['\"]\])", r"\1Background\2", bpy_script)

import re, os
if os.path.exists('output/blender_execution.log'):
    with open('output/blender_execution.log', 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as lf:
        content = lf.read()
    
    tb_match = re.search(r'(Traceback \(most recent call last\):[\s\S]+?(?:[A-Za-z0-9_]+Error|[A-Za-z0-9_]+Exception):[^\n]+)', content)
    if tb_match:
        traceback_str = tb_match.group(1).strip()
        with open('output/error.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as ef:
            ef.write(traceback_str + '\n')
        print("EXTRACTED TRACEBACK TO error.txt:\n" + traceback_str)
EOF

# Normalize any exported .glb to model.glb so the Android app can consume it
if [ ! -f output/model.glb ]; then
  FIRST_GLB=$(ls output/*.glb 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
  if [ -n "$FIRST_GLB" ]; then
    cp "$FIRST_GLB" output/model.glb
    echo "Normalized $FIRST_GLB -> output/model.glb"
  fi
fi

# Normalize any rendered .mp4 to cinematic.mp4
if [ ! -f output/cinematic.mp4 ]; then
  FIRST_MP4=$(ls output/*.mp4 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
  if [ -n "$FIRST_MP4" ]; then
    cp "$FIRST_MP4" output/cinematic.mp4
    echo "Normalized $FIRST_MP4 -> output/cinematic.mp4"
  fi
fi

# Verify output assets
if [ -f output/model.glb ]; then
  echo "SUCCESS: model.glb generated successfully."
  if [ -f output/cinematic.mp4 ]; then
    echo "SUCCESS: cinematic.mp4 video generated successfully ($(stat -c%s output/cinematic.mp4) bytes)."
  fi
  exit 0
else
  if [ ! -f output/error.txt ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Blender execution halted without generating model.glb" > output/error.txt
    tail -n 40 output/blender_execution.log >> output/error.txt
  fi
  exit 1
fi
